name: Fight Ippatsu! Juden-Chan!! CC
original_name: ファイト一発！充電ちゃん!!CC
source:
Plug is from another world, Life Core. She is actually a charger (Judenchan) who gives vitality to people!! She lives a busy life with Sento, who can see Plug, and Aresta, another charger. One day, a rookie charger appears in front of Plug and asks for training. Well, will she be able to train her smoothly? What is the purpose of the rookie charger?

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/75_23_134/products_id/14396]HimeyaShop[/url]]
